## HEIDMAR MARITIME HOLDINGS CORP. ANNOUNCES TRANSITION IN CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER ROLE


June 2, 2026


Athens / New York, 1st June 2026 – Heidmar Maritime Holdings Corp. (the “Company” or “Heidmar”) (NASDAQ: HMR) today announced a transition in its finance leadership. Mrs Niki Fotiou no longer holds the position of Chief Financial Officer, effective 31st May 2026.[Read More](https://www.heidmar.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/HEIDMAR-MARITIME-HOLDINGS-CORP.-ANNOUNCES-TRANSITION-IN-CHIEF-FINANCIAL-OFFICER-ROLE.pdf)
